title: Code and data for: How many heat invariants determine a hyperbolic orbifold?
description: Code and data for the paper How many heat invariants determine a hyperbolic orbifold? and its supplement: the exact-arithmetic checks of the theorems on heat invariants of closed hyperbolic 2-orbifolds, the Prouhet-Tarry-Escott constructions and searches, the stability constants and certificates, the computer algebra of variable curvature, the finite-element eigenvalues of the minimal triangle pair and of a moduli family with their validation, the figures and the generated tables. make verify reruns the fast checks and make all everything; DATA.md lists every data file with its checksum, producing script and paper element, and TRACE.md maps every checkable item of the paper to its script.
